title: EDMVersionPayload
description: Schema for Exclusive Download Manager Two-Tier Remote Update Payload

version.description: Semantic version of the latest release (e.g. '1.1.0')

minSupportedVersion.description: Minimum client version allowed. Any version below this is forced to update.

forceUpdate.description: Set true for Tier 1 (Mandatory/Forced Update), false for Tier 2 (Optional Update).

title.description: Human readable release headline or announcement.

downloadUrl.description: Direct HTTPS URL to the EDMSetup.exe installer binary.

sha256.description: Cryptographic SHA256 checksum of the installer binary for client-side integrity validation.

changelog.description: List of bullet points detailing features, bug fixes, and improvements.
